correctness.rationale: The formula follows directly from additive character orthogonality: K(a,b,c)=q sum_{a+cy²=0} ψ(by); in odd characteristic root fibers are q, 1, 0, or 2 and a two-root fiber gives 2q cos(2πTr(br)/p). Nontrivial trace linear functionals have q/p fibers, so sum|K|=q³+q²(q-1)²/p sum_{j=0}^{p-1}|cos(2πj/p)|; the last sum is exactly csc(π/(2p)). Unweighted counting-measure convolution l-infinity norm is exactly its kernel l1 sum, attained by matching phases. The q(q-1), q(q-1)²/2 and origin strata give support 1+(q³-q)/2. Quadratic xy comparison equals q-1+q^-1 and limits follow. Independently direct original double-character sums for p=3,5,7 returned exact support counts 13,61,169 and norms 1.888888888889,3.0710835056,4.301684315666 agreeing with formula. Finite tests only corroborate unrestricted finite-field proof.
